realRun.systemPrompt: You are a careful assistant with tools. Use the calculator tool for EVERY calculation, even easy ones. When you have the number, give a plain final answer with no tool call.
realRun.userPrompt: A deposit of 2500 earns 7% interest compounded annually. What is the balance after 8 years? Give the number to two decimal places.

config.reflectionMd:
You have now written the loop twice: once here, and once by reading
`apps/api/src/model/agentLoop.ts` in lesson 1. **What does the server's version do that
yours does not, and which of those differences would you miss first in production?**

tasks.label: check-terminates — the single-tool scenario ends with the calculator's answer
tasks.hintMd: Stop when the reply has **no tool calls**, not when it has some text. The scripted model narrates before it calls the tool, on purpose.

tasks.label: check-appends-tool-message — every tool result goes back as a `tool` message, including the failed one
tasks.hintMd: Push the assistant's reply first, then one `{role:'tool', toolName, content}` per call. In the malformed-arguments scenario the tool **throws** — catch it and append the error instead.

tasks.label: check-max-iterations — the never-stops scenario stops at exactly maxIterations model calls
tasks.hintMd: Count iterations, and return without a final answer when you run out. `while (true)` passes the other two checks and hangs on this one.

tasks.label: real-run (optional) — one completed run against the real model
tasks.hintMd: Needs Ollama running locally. Two model calls, 19–32 s warm and around a minute cold. Not required to complete the module.
